title: Nourishing Arabian Eggplant Tagine
description: A winey, velvety tagine that melds tender eggplant and peas in a fragrant, Mediterranean-friendly sauce, perfect for meal prep.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a heavy-bottom pot over medium heat until shimmering.
Add the diced onion and sauté until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic and grated ginger, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the sliced eggplant, peas, tomato passata, and ground spices, stirring to coat the vegetables.
Pour in the vegetable stock, bring the mixture to a gentle boil, then reduce heat to low.
Cover the pot and simmer for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the eggplant is tender and the sauce thickens.
Season with salt and pepper, adjusting to taste, and let the tagine rest uncovered for 5 minutes.
Sprinkle chopped cilantro over the top before serving to add freshness.
Optionally, drizzle a little extra olive oil or a splash of wine for a winey finish.
